name: Periodic damage grants Hourglass of Eternity's haste (#1294)
contract: Original Hourglass of Eternity 806337 has a 5 percent periodic-damage proc chance, triggering the
five-second 25 percent spell-haste aura 504726. Twenty cohorts of three funded ordinary Decomposition
casts produce at least 300 actual damaging ticks: zero procs then has probability at most 0.95^300, about
2.1e-7. Count native periodic damage rather than submitted casts and check the authored 5 percent chance
with an exact binomial test. Sample the native aura amount and cast-speed multiplier throughout, require a
triggered haste cast and its actual 1/1.25 casting-speed benefit, then verify expiration restores
baseline. Preserve proc chance, duration, tick cadence, mana costs, hit calculation and ordinary session
casting; repeated casts provide the sample without retries or self-inflicted DoT fixtures.
